title: fix: let Claude Code use Fireworks text models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes unsupported Anthropic `cache_control` markers from messages sent to direct Fireworks models.
- Keeps existing reasoning and audio transforms, and leaves other providers unchanged.
- Adds focused coverage for all eight affected model routes.

Tests: 51 focused Gen tests passed; Gen typecheck passed.

Fixes #15682

gist.headline: Claude Code meets Fireworks
gist.blurb: Claude Code can now talk to direct Fireworks text models without bringing along cache markers they don’t understand. Eight model routes got the fix; the other providers stayed as they were.
gist.summary: Direct Fireworks text model requests now strip unsupported Anthropic cache_control markers, fixing Claude Code compatibility across eight model routes while preserving reasoning and audio transforms.
gist.impact: Claude Code users can send requests through the eight affected Fireworks routes without cache_control markers causing failures; other providers behave as before.
gist.visual_concept: Show Polli helping a Claude Code terminal send eight little message cards toward a softly glowing Fireworks sign, gently removing cache_control tags before they arrive. Keep the fireworks as warm pastel sparkles, with code-plants around the terminal.
